reasons_add: Al-Tabari identifies the destination of Moses' guidance as the true religion.
Ibn Kathir expressly says Moses offers to guide Pharaoh to worship his Lord.
Al-Tabari specifies that this guidance is to what pleases Pharaoh's Lord, namely the true religion.
Al-Tabari says Pharaoh would fear God's punishment by fulfilling obligations and avoiding prohibitions. Ibn Kathir describes the resulting fear with humility and obedience.
Al-Tabari connects fear of punishment with fulfilling obligations and avoiding prohibitions. Ibn Kathir says guidance would make Pharaoh humble and obedient instead of hard and corrupt.
